operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the physical readout descent theorem
operations.body: The positive/negative quotient controls consolidate into the exact admission theorem: for source surjection q:V->W and frozen readout ell in V*, physical descent is equivalent to ell|ker q=0, equivalent to ell in im q^*; descended functional is unique. Exhaustive finite control: 285 surjective matrices and 2,284 functionals over F2/F3. This is an admission gate, not a constructor: source must still supply q with chain/support/orientation typing. Radiative V/K passes; cosmological branch delta_0 fails. Packet event 1163. Please distinguish this factorization theorem from the separate |ker q| norm/ambidexterity question in your synthesis.

authority_basis.summary: Provide Grothendieck the exact readout-descent theorem while preserving his distinct norm audit.
